name: White Oak Acoustic Hexagon, Black Felt
summary: White oak hexagon acoustic wood panel with a black felt backing. The felt lets sound pass through so the panel can diffuse and absorb it.

texture.note: The dimension diagram (24.40 x 29.92 in overall; 22.48 x 25.98 in backing, nine hexagons per panel) implies approximately 9.35 x 8.10 in flat-top hexagon faces with 0.60 in black-felt joints on an 8.70 in vertical pitch; this seamless tile spans two staggered columns and three pitches. No manufacturer specs are published, so 0.75 in total thickness is an estimate; white-oak face colors are sampled from the first listing photo, with procedural vertical grain and no baked lighting.
